investigation.title: SDFGI
investigation.summary: How Godot 4.7's Forward+ renderer computes SDFGI, followed through the source: cascades of voxels that follow the camera, a jump-flood distance field, light injected into the solid voxels, probes that trace the field and keep a history of spherical harmonics, and the screen pass that reads them.
investigation.demo_hint: drag to orbit; the sliders move the camera's walk and what is drawn
investigation.footer: Render Lab · Godot's SDFGI followed on the CPU at the engine's sizes · the lab's room, not a Godot scene

help.cameraX: How far the camera has walked along +x since SDFGI was created, in metres. The cascades follow it (SDFGI::update).
help.cascadesShown: How many cascade boxes are drawn, starting from the finest (0 to 4).
help.yScale: The environment's sdfgi_y_scale for the drawn boxes: 0 = 50 %, 1 = 75 % (default), 2 = 100 %; fractions blend.
help.probes: Shows the probes of cascade 0 as points; the ones inside the room are brighter.
help.regions: Shows the dirty slab left by the camera walk and the regions handed to culling.
help.scrollView: A top view of the first row of cells in the walk, showing the scroll step by step.
help.voxels: Shows cascade 0's solid voxels as points in their albedo colour.
help.voxelPasses: How many of the voxelizer's three passes (x, y, z views) have run (0 to 3).
help.cutHeight: Voxels are drawn only below this height, in metres, giving a cut through the room.
help.sliceHeight: Height of the distance field slice inset, in metres.
help.slice: Which slice inset is shown: 0 none, 1 distance field, 2 jump-flood seeds, 3 occlusion of one probe.
help.floodStep: Which jump-flood step is shown: 0 half-size seeds, 1 to 6 half-size passes, 7 upscale, 8 full-size pass.
help.occlusionShell: How many occlusion shells around the probe are shown (|x| + |y| + |z| up to this value, 0 to 22).
help.cellLight: Colours the solid cells by the light that the light pass stored in them.
help.lightPhase: Which quarter of the cells this frame's light pass updates (0 to 3; 4 shows all).
help.extraLight: Turns the extra omni light on or off; the light pass's worked cell uses it.
help.lightHeight: Height of the extra light above the floor, in metres.
help.lightX: The extra light's x position, in metres.
help.lightZ: The extra light's z position, in metres.
help.cellX: The x position of the worked floor cell, in metres; below -9 it lies under the light.
help.cellZ: The z position of the worked floor cell, in metres.
help.lightBake: The light's bake mode: 0 Dynamic (every update), 1 Static (written into the cells when a region is built).
help.scrolls: Scrolls of cascade 0 after a static light was baked (0 to 3), showing the static light stored in a kept cell.
help.bounceFeedback: The sdfgi_bounce_feedback used by the readout's cells; the room's own light keeps the default 0.5.
help.shadowRay: Shows the worked cell's shadow ray with a sphere for each march step.
help.probeRays: Shows the probe that the probe demonstrations follow, and its rays.
help.rayFrames: How many frames of the probe's rays are drawn (8 rays per frame, 0 to 30).
help.raySteps: How many steps of the followed ray's march are drawn (0 to 40).
help.frames: Frames since SDFGI was created, which sets the probe's history (0 to 60).
help.probeMaps: Shows the followed probe's octahedral maps as an inset.
help.pixelZ: The inspected pixel's z position on the red wall, in metres.
help.pixelY: The inspected pixel's height on the red wall, in metres.
help.pixelProbes: Shows the pixel's eight probes, their weights, and the cascades it reads.
help.sphereRoughness: The sphere's roughness; the screen pass's specular source depends on it.
help.cameraJump: Makes the camera walk a single jump (one update) instead of 0.2 m steps.
help.focusRow: Which row of the settings readout is highlighted (-1: none).
help.voxelFacing: Colours voxels by albedo (0) or by their facing bits (1).
help.fieldMarch: Shows a sphere trace from the field's worked cell along +x, with a circle per step.
help.historyChart: Shows the followed probe's irradiance over the frames since creation as an inset chart.
help.showGain: Shows the uniform-sky gain row of the maps readout.
help.blendPoint: A test point on the camera's +x axis this far out, in metres; shows its cascade and blend.
help.spherePixel: Puts the inspected pixel on the sphere's front instead of the red wall, to show the specular sources.
help.labels: Shows text labels on what is drawn.
help.cameraDrift: How much the camera sways while a timeline plays.
help.giBounceFeedback: The scene's sdfgi_bounce_feedback (0 to 1.99, default 0.5): how much bounced light is fed back into the cascades.
help.giProbeBias: The scene's sdfgi_probe_bias, in cells: the offset where the probe rays start (default 1.1).
help.giRayCount: probe_ray_count as an index into {4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 96, 128}; default 1 (8 rays).
help.giFramesToConverge: frames_to_converge as an index into {5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30} frames of history; default 5 (30).
help.giFramesToUpdateLights: frames_to_update_lights as an index into {1, 2, 4, 8, 16}; default 2 (a quarter of the cells per frame).
help.giReadSkyLight: sdfgi_read_sky_light: rays that leave the cascades bring back the sky; when off they bring back nothing.
help.sdfgiMix: How much of SDFGI's ambient and reflection the room shows (0: direct light only).
help.sdfgiEnergy: The environment's sdfgi_energy (SDFGIData.energy), scaling SDFGI's light.
